metadata.name: nexus
metadata.description: Nexus Anchor program: devnet-first capsule/token launch with two-tier referrals, proportional allocation, 72h vesting and early-claim burns.

instructions.name: activate_launch
docs: Start the 72-hour vesting clock. Authority only.
Requires finalisation AND an executed migration: claims must
never start before the vault SOL has moved to liquidity /
treasury, or claimants would hold tokens with no market.
Can only run once.

instructions.name: cancel_migration
docs: Cancel a pending migration proposal. Authority only. The
proposal can be re-made afterwards.

instructions.name: cancel_sale
docs: Cancel the sale before finalisation. Authority only.
After cancellation, deposits, finalisation and airdrop
registration are closed; contributors may `refund` the
pool-held part of their deposits.

instructions.name: claim_airdrop
docs: Claim airdrop tokens that have vested. Linear 72h vesting from
launch activation, NO early-claim penalty. Registration time
does not restart the clock.

instructions.name: claim_locked
docs: Claim vested tokens from a TokenLock. Beneficiary only.
Linear vesting after the cliff; claims the newly vested
amount (vested − already claimed).

instructions.name: claim_presale
docs: Claim presale tokens that have vested.
* Retail (cumulative gross <= 2 SOL): fully claimable after
finalisation + launch activation.
* Whale (cumulative gross > 2 SOL): linear vesting over
259,200 s from `launch_ts`; early claims pay a penalty on
the newly claimed amount only: 25% <24h, 15% 24–48h,
5% 48–72h, 0% after. 80% of the penalty is burned with the
real SPL burn instruction; 20% goes to the rewards escrow.
* `gross_claimed` is updated by the full gross claim, so the
same tokens can never be claimed twice.

instructions.name: create_lock
docs: Create a TokenLock grant. Authority only. The `total` tokens
are moved at creation from the authority's holding into the
lock escrow (owned by the TokenLock PDA). Total locked across
all locks is capped at 350M tokens — the 500M remainder minus
the 150M reserved for liquidity.

accounts.name: source
docs: Authority's holding of the remaining 500M; funds the lock.

accounts.name: lock_escrow
docs: Token account holding the locked tokens. Owner must be the
TokenLock PDA (it signs releases via its seeds).

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Accept one SOL contribution.
`direct_referrer` / `upline` are accounts, not bare pubkeys:
they receive lamports, so they must be passed as mutable
accounts. Pass the pool authority account for both when there
is no referrer — the authority address is the no-referral
sentinel (routing, not an earned founder commission).
`referrer_position` is optional: pass the direct referrer's
Position account when it exists, so the program can verify the
upline is the referrer's referrer. Omit it (null) only when the
referrer has never deposited — then `upline` must be the sentinel.

accounts.name: direct_referrer
docs: there is no referrer (sentinel). Receives lamports if valid.

accounts.name: upline
docs: no upline (sentinel). Receives lamports if valid.

accounts.name: referrer_position
docs: The direct referrer's Position, when it exists. Verified
manually in the handler (PDA + referrer == upline). Pass null
when the referrer has never deposited.

instructions.name: execute_migration
docs: Execute the migration after the timelock. Authority only.
One-time. Splits the distributable vault SOL (Pool balance
minus its rent-exempt minimum) 85% to the designated
DEX-liquidity wallet and 15% to the treasury wallet, and
transfers exactly 150,000,000 liquidity tokens from the
authority's holding into the recorded liquidity token escrow.
The multisig then creates the Raydium CPMM pool off-chain
from those wallets and records its address.

accounts.name: liquidity_dest
docs: the handler (after the timelock checks) so errors stay specific.

accounts.name: liquidity_token_source
docs: Authority's holding of the remaining 500M; funds the 150M.

accounts.name: liquidity_token_dest
docs: must be pool.migration_liquidity_dest — both verified in the
handler (see execute_migration). Only the mint is checked here.

instructions.name: finalize
docs: Close the sale. Authority only. Freezes `total_gross`, which
fixes every wallet's proportional allocation. Requires the
token escrow to still hold >= 500M tokens.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Create the Pool. Authority-gated: the signer becomes
`pool.authority` and must approve every later authority action.
Gates enforced here (v2.0 Gate 2):
* mint has 6 decimals, exactly 1,000,000,000 tokens minted, and
mint + freeze authority revoked;
* token escrow (owned by the Pool PDA) holds >= 500,000,000
tokens (400M presale + 100M airdrop).
The remaining 500M tokens are NOT minted into this escrow. Their
RECOMMENDED allocation (150M liquidity / 100M ecosystem /
100M team / 100M treasury / 50M marketing, v2.0 p. 7) requires
founder approval and a locking/vesting mechanism that does not
yet exist — it is not created, claimed, or promised here.

instructions.name: pause_deposits
docs: Pause or unpause deposits. Authority only. Claims, refunds
and migration are never paused.

instructions.name: propose_migration
docs: Propose the one-time migration. Authority only. Requires a
finalised (not cancelled, not launched) sale and no active
proposal. Sets the destinations and the 72h timelock; nothing
moves yet. The liquidity token escrow is recorded here and
must be the same account at execution.

accounts.name: liquidity_token_escrow
docs: Token account that will receive the 150M liquidity tokens at
execution. Mint and owner (must be the designated liquidity
wallet) are verified in the handler, after the
already-executed / already-proposed checks, so a second
proposal after execution surfaces MigrationAlreadyExecuted
instead of a raw constraint failure.

instructions.name: record_liquidity_pool
docs: Record the DEX pool address after the multisig creates the
pool off-chain. Authority only, once, only after migration.

instructions.name: refund
docs: Refund one contributor's pool-held deposits after cancellation.
Pays exactly `position.vault_contribution` from the Pool PDA,
once. Referral shares already paid out are NOT refundable and
are not part of `vault_contribution`.

instructions.name: register_airdrop
docs: Register an airdrop allocation with a Merkle proof.
Replay-protected: the Airdrop PDA can only be initialised once.
The root is immutable in this phase — the approved list must be
right before `initialize` sets it.

instructions.name: rotate_authority
docs: Rotate the pool authority to a new pubkey. Current authority
only. The no-referral sentinel is NOT rotated (see state.rs):
existing no-referrer positions keep working.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero.

errors.name: ArithmeticError
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow or underflow (checked arithmetic failed).

errors.name: SaleFinalized
errors.msg: Sale is already finalised; deposits are closed.

errors.name: SaleNotFinalized
errors.msg: Sale has not been finalised yet.

errors.name: LaunchNotActivated
errors.msg: Launch has not been activated yet.

errors.name: LaunchAlreadyActivated
errors.msg: Launch is already activated.

errors.name: CapExceeded
errors.msg: Deposit would exceed the 15,000 SOL hard cap.

errors.name: SelfReferral
errors.msg: A wallet cannot refer itself.

errors.name: ReferralCycle
errors.msg: Referral ancestry is invalid: upline must be the direct referrer's referrer, or the authority sentinel when the referrer has no referrer.

errors.name: ReferrerAlreadyBound
errors.msg: A wallet's referrer is fixed on its first deposit and cannot be changed.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Caller is not the pool authority.

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: Mint must have 6 decimals, exactly 1,000,000,000 tokens minted, and no mint or freeze authority.

errors.name: EscrowUnderfunded
errors.msg: Token escrow is underfunded: it must hold at least 500,000,000 tokens (400M presale + 100M airdrop) at finalisation.

errors.name: NothingClaimable
errors.msg: Nothing is claimable yet (vested amount minus already-claimed is zero).

errors.name: AlreadyRegistered
errors.msg: This wallet has already registered its airdrop allocation (Merkle replay protection).

errors.name: InvalidMerkleProof
errors.msg: Merkle proof does not match the approved root for this wallet and allocation.

errors.name: AirdropCapExceeded
errors.msg: Airdrop registrations would exceed the 100,000,000-token inventory.

errors.name: ZeroTotalGross
errors.msg: Total gross contributions are zero; allocation is undefined.

errors.name: SaleCancelled
errors.msg: Sale was cancelled before finalisation; deposits and finalisation are closed.

errors.name: AlreadyRefunded
errors.msg: This position has already been refunded; its allocation is void.

errors.name: RefundNotAvailable
errors.msg: Refunds are only available after the sale is cancelled (and only before finalisation).

errors.name: NothingToRefund
errors.msg: Nothing to refund: this position holds no vault contribution.

errors.name: DepositsPaused
errors.msg: Deposits are paused by the authority.

errors.name: MigrationNotProposed
errors.msg: No migration has been proposed.

errors.name: MigrationTooEarly
errors.msg: The migration timelock has not expired yet.

errors.name: MigrationAlreadyExecuted
errors.msg: Migration has already been executed.

errors.name: MigrationNotExecuted
errors.msg: Migration has not been executed yet.

errors.name: InvalidMigrationDestination
errors.msg: Migration destination is invalid (zero address, or the pool itself).

errors.name: InvalidLockParams
errors.msg: Token lock parameters are invalid: total and duration must be positive, cliff must be within the duration.

errors.name: LockBudgetExceeded
errors.msg: Token locks would exceed the 350,000,000-token non-liquidity budget.

errors.name: LiquidityPoolAlreadyRecorded
errors.msg: A liquidity pool address has already been recorded.

errors.name: MigrationAlreadyProposed
errors.msg: A migration is already proposed; cancel it before proposing another.

errors.name: LiquidityFundingShort
errors.msg: Liquidity token source holds fewer than 150,000,000 tokens.

errors.name: InvalidAuthority
errors.msg: New authority is invalid (zero address, or unchanged).

types.name: AirdropAccount
docs: One airdrop recipient's registration. PDA seeds: ["airdrop", wallet].

fields.name: allocation
docs: Approved allocation, in base units (from the Merkle list).

fields.name: gross_claimed
docs: Gross tokens already claimed, in base units.

types.name: Pool
docs: Global sale state. PDA seeds: ["pool"].
The Pool account itself holds the protocol SOL vault: deposits send
the vault share directly to this PDA.
Phase 3 (money-out) adds the escape paths that were deliberately
absent before: vault-portion refunds after a pre-finalise
cancellation, and a one-time, timelocked migration of the vault
SOL (85% to a designated DEX-liquidity wallet, 15% to the
treasury wallet) plus exactly 150,000,000 liquidity tokens.
See `workspace/goals/nexus-build-and-github-push/files/nexus-phase3-money-out-design.md`
and `hidden_files/phase3-build-log.md` for the design and the one
documented deviation (the liquidity share is held by a
multisig-designated wallet, not a program-owned PDA, because a
program-owned PDA cannot be spent by the off-chain multisig that
must create the Raydium pool).

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority that may initialise, finalise and activate the launch.
Production value (public address only, from v2.0):
BHxkjg3MvcWitw6i2MQDNrCWmC6vqB5U98C3JUk8LmTB
The program never holds or asks for this key. It is stored at
`initialize` from the signer, and verified off-chain.
Meant to be a multisig (e.g. Squads) address on mainnet.

fields.name: sentinel
docs: The no-referral sentinel, fixed at `initialize` to the
authority at that time. It is deliberately NOT rotated with
`rotate_authority`: existing positions store this address as
their referrer, and rotating it would break their repeat
deposits. The sentinel is routing, never a privilege.

fields.name: mint
docs: The NEXUS SPL mint (6 decimals, 1B supply, authorities revoked).

fields.name: token_escrow
docs: Token account holding the 400M presale + 100M airdrop escrow.
Owner must be this Pool PDA.

fields.name: rewards_escrow
docs: Token account receiving the 20% rewards share of whale penalties.
Owner must be this Pool PDA.

fields.name: total_gross
docs: Sum of all accepted gross contributions, in lamports.

fields.name: sale_finalized
docs: True once `finalize` has run. Deposits are rejected after this.

fields.name: launch_activated
docs: True once `activate_launch` has run.

fields.name: launch_ts
docs: Unix timestamp set by `activate_launch`; the 72h vesting clock
starts here. 0 until activation.

fields.name: merkle_root
docs: Merkle root of the approved airdrop list. Immutable in this phase:
a mistake in the list cannot be casually fixed after `initialize`.

fields.name: airdrop_registered_total
docs: Sum of airdrop allocations registered so far, in base units.
Capped at 100,000,000 tokens.

fields.name: airdrop_claimed_total
docs: Sum of airdrop tokens gross-claimed so far, in base units.
Capped at 100,000,000 tokens.

fields.name: sale_cancelled
docs: True once `cancel_sale` has run (only before finalisation).
Deposits, finalisation and airdrop registration are closed.

fields.name: deposits_paused
docs: True while `pause_deposits` is in effect. Deposits only:
claims, refunds and migration are never paused.

fields.name: locked_tokens_total
docs: Sum of tokens locked in TokenLock accounts, in base units.
Capped at 350,000,000 (the 500M remainder minus the 150M
reserved for liquidity).

fields.name: migration_proposed_at
docs: Unix timestamp of `propose_migration`. 0 when no proposal active.

fields.name: migration_execute_after
docs: Earliest `execute_migration` time (proposed_at + 72h). 0 when none.

fields.name: migration_liquidity_dest
docs: Designated DEX-liquidity wallet (multisig). Receives 85% of the
distributable vault SOL at execution.

fields.name: migration_treasury_dest
docs: Treasury wallet (multisig). Receives 15% at execution.

fields.name: liquidity_token_escrow
docs: Token account that receives the 150M liquidity tokens at
execution. Owner must be `migration_liquidity_dest`.

fields.name: migration_sol_liquidity
docs: Lamports sent to the liquidity destination at execution. 0 until then.

fields.name: migration_sol_treasury
docs: Lamports sent to the treasury at execution. 0 until then.

fields.name: migration_executed
docs: True once `execute_migration` has run. Migration is one-time.

fields.name: liquidity_pool_address
docs: DEX pool address recorded by `record_liquidity_pool` after the
multisig creates the pool off-chain. Default (zero) until then.

fields.name: treasury_withdrawn_total
docs: Total SOL ever sent to the treasury (the migration share only;
there is no second withdrawal path from the Pool).

types.name: Position
docs: One contributor's position. PDA seeds: ["position", contributor].
`gross_contribution` is cumulative: tier is decided by the total,
so splitting one big purchase into small payments does not preserve
retail status. `allocation` is NOT stored here — it is computed
deterministically at claim time as
`gross / pool.total_gross * 400,000,000 tokens` (see nexus-math),
which is exactly the allocation `finalize` fixes, because
`total_gross` is frozen by finalisation.
Phase 3: `vault_contribution` tracks exactly how many lamports of
this contributor's deposits actually landed in the Pool (the vault
share of each deposit, including redirected referral shares).
That is the refundable amount if the sale is cancelled before
finalisation. Referral shares already paid out are NOT refundable
and are NOT included here.

fields.name: gross_contribution
docs: Cumulative accepted gross contribution, in lamports.

fields.name: referrer
docs: Direct referrer, or the pool authority address as the
no-referral sentinel. Bound on first deposit, never changed.

fields.name: upline
docs: Referrer's referrer, or the pool authority sentinel.

fields.name: gross_claimed
docs: Gross tokens already claimed (presale), in base units.
Prevents the same allocation being extracted twice.

fields.name: vault_contribution
docs: Lamports of this contributor's deposits held in the Pool vault.
Refundable (once) if the sale is cancelled before finalisation.

fields.name: refunded
docs: True once `refund` has run. Allocation is void after a refund.

types.name: TokenLock
docs: One locked token grant. PDA seeds:
["token_lock", beneficiary, lock_id (u64 LE)].
Linear vesting after a cliff: nothing vests before
`start + cliff_seconds`; after that, `total` vests linearly over
`duration_seconds`. The locked tokens sit in a token account
owned by this PDA (`lock_escrow`), funded once at `create_lock`
from the authority's holding of the remaining 500M. `claimed`
tracks what the beneficiary has already taken, so the same
tokens can never be claimed twice.

fields.name: beneficiary
docs: Wallet that may claim the vested tokens.

fields.name: mint
docs: The NEXUS SPL mint.

fields.name: total
docs: Total locked amount, in base units.

fields.name: start
docs: Unix timestamp vesting is measured from.

fields.name: cliff_seconds
docs: Seconds after `start` before anything vests (0 = no cliff).

fields.name: duration_seconds
docs: Seconds of linear vesting after the cliff.

fields.name: claimed
docs: Base units already claimed.
